email.subject: AI for Sperber, Hoffman, Stein & Scampoli, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Leonard,

Your firm was founded in 2022, which means you're building something intentional from the ground up. That's exactly the mindset we see in the fastest-growing practices we work with.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now connecting with regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete with BigLaw without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
